data.notes: September's confirmed Mykonos calendar is led by Scorpios' sunset music program, with select late-night Cavo Paradiso dates also verified.

events.title: Agoria, Little D
events.summary: Agoria plays Scorpios' Sunset Area with Little D on the venue's published September program. The listing describes a night of rich compositions, high-energy sonic exploration, and cross-cultural blends.

events.title: Caiiro x Enoo Napa x Da Capo, Jane Ryse
events.summary: Scorpios lists a B3B-style Afro Tech showcase from Caiiro, Enoo Napa and Da Capo, joined by Jane Ryse. This is one of the strongest Afro-house/afro-tech bookings on the September schedule.

events.title: Scorpios Label Night with Jean Claude Ades B2B TBA, Lannka B2B Valeron
events.summary: Scorpios' own label roster gathers for a dedicated label night featuring Jean Claude Ades and a Lannka B2B Valeron session. The program frames it as a label session celebrating fresh releases and genre-fluid sunset music.

events.title: Jimi Jules, Carly Sant
events.summary: Innervisions artist Jimi Jules headlines Scorpios' Terrace with Carly Sant. The venue listing highlights deep nocturnal dancefloor selections and eclectic intensity.

events.title: Shimza, Jean Claude Ades
events.summary: Shimza appears at Scorpios with Jean Claude Ades for a Terrace session. The official listing positions Shimza at the forefront of global Afro House and pairs him with Ades' sunset-to-night selections.

events.title: Lee Burridge
events.summary: All Day I Dream founder Lee Burridge plays Scorpios' Terrace. The official program describes an organic-house and progressive-leaning journey rooted in emotion, atmosphere and melodic depth.

events.title: Satori (Live), PAAX
events.summary: Satori brings a live set to Scorpios with PAAX. The listing emphasizes groove-laden electronica, live instrumental builds and experimental rhythmic dance music.

events.title: Liva K
events.summary: Bandsintown lists Liva K at Cavo Paradiso, Mykonos on September 19, 2026 at 11:30 PM. The event is tagged around deep house, Afro house and house.

events.title: Damian Lazarus, Little D
events.summary: Damian Lazarus headlines Scorpios' Terrace with Little D. The official listing bills Lazarus as a house-and-techno storyteller, with Little D supplying a genre-spanning support journey.

events.title: DJ Snake | Dany Neville
events.summary: Cavo Paradiso's official Summer 2026 lineup page lists DJ Snake and Dany Neville for a September 24 late-night event. It is one of the biggest mainstream electronic bookings currently visible for Mykonos in September 2026.

events.title: Valeron & Band (Live)
events.summary: Valeron & Band are listed at Scorpios' Sunset Area on September 26. The program describes a live set using Greek instrumentation including satur, Cretan lyra and bouzouki within a pulsing house soundscape.

events.title: Jean Claude Ades, Marten Lou
events.summary: Jean Claude Ades plays Scorpios' Terrace with Marten Lou. The official listing highlights Marten Lou's high-energy performance style alongside Ades' versatile sunset selections.
